displayName.ja: 【水陸両用制服】 天泣　憂

profile.ja: 五車学園所属の対魔忍。雨遁の術を得意としており、局所的に雨を降らすことが出来る。晴れている状態から雨を降らすにはかなりの体力を必要とするが、降水量を加減したり、風雨を起こす程度であれば、お手軽にやってのけるようだ。手持ちの仕込み傘（ガンブレラ）は科学班による特注忍具。調合した薬剤を空中に向かって撃ち出すと、治療薬や毒入りの雨を降らせることが可能である。学園生活においても雨が大好きな彼女の制服は、濡れても快適な素材で作られた特別製。雨の日の休み時間は野山に出かけて、カエルやカタツムリを採取しにいくのが彼女の楽しみである。一方、晴れている日は水分を求めて、こっそりプールに忍び込むこともあるようだ。
profile.en: She is a Taimanin of Gosha Academy who excels at rain-style ninjutsu, capable of creating localized rain. Turning clear skies into rain requires considerable stamina, but she can easily adjust rainfall or summon wind and rain. Her custom-made umbrella (Gunbrella) is a special ninja tool from the science division; firing mixed chemicals into the air lets her produce healing or poisonous rain, making her a rear-line support in outdoor battles. Even without ninjutsu she's a natural rain-girl, loving solitary walks on rainy days. She dislikes sunlight and wilts under direct midsummer sun. A relaxed personality, she enjoys staying in her room, reading to the sound of rain and caring for pet tree frogs and snails. Most of her friends are indoor-type, but she gets along with anyone active enough to ignore the rain. Her uniform, made from a special water-friendly fabric, stays comfortable even when soaked. On rainy breaks she heads into the fields to collect frogs and snails, while on sunny days she secretly sneaks into the pool for a drink of water.

text.ja: やっほ～、憂だよぉ。雨の日に学校で会うのはめずらしいねぇ、って言っても、私がよく、裏山なんかに遊びに行ってるからかなぁ？
text.en: Hey hey, it's Ui! It's rare to see you at school on a rainy day… maybe that's because I'm often out exploring the hills behind the school?

text.ja: うぅ～、あづいぃ……あ、隊長さぁん……晴れの日は、やっぱりねぇ、つらい……しんどい……日陰、早く日陰にぃ……
text.en: Ugh… it's so hot… Ah, Captain… sunny days are just… tough… exhausting… please, a shade… quickly…

text.ja: よかったぁ～、雨だぁ～。じゃ、ちょっと行ってくるねぇ。どこにって、お山のほうだよ。湿気が多いと、カエルも増えるからねぇ
text.en: Yay, rain! I'm heading out now. Where to? Up the mountain. The humidity brings out more frogs, you know.

text.ja: お～、カエル～、カタツムリ～……え？　た、食べないよっ、食べるわけないでしょ！　飼わない子は、すぐ逃がすよぉ
text.en: Oh, frogs… snails… what? N-no, I'm not eating them! I'd never do that! If I don't keep them, I let them go right away.

text.ja: 制服の生地が、みんなとちょっと違うって？　あ～、それはねぇ、水に濡れても大丈夫な素材だからだよ、私専用のねぇ
text.en: You think the uniform fabric is a bit different? Ah, that's because it's made from a material that stays fine even when soaked—my own special version.

text.ja: この制服ねぇ、着衣水泳とかにも向いてるんだよ。まぁ特注だもんねぇ、その分お高いから、全員のをこれにするのは大変だろうね～
text.en: This uniform even works for swimming in clothes. Well, it's custom-made, so it's pricey; swapping everyone's gear for this would be a hassle.

text.ja: ん～っ、気持ちいい～♪　隊長さんもおいでよ、誰もいないプールなんて、めったに味わえないよぉ？
text.en: Mmm, feels great♪ Captain, come join me—rarely do you get a pool all to yourself, you know?

text.ja: 雨の中、プールに入るのも気持ちいいんだけど……それだと、隊長さんが風邪ひいちゃうだろうからね。いまはやめとく
text.en: Jumping into a pool in the rain feels amazing, but I don't want you catching a cold, Captain, so I'll hold off for now.

text.ja: ふふふ……ウェット＆メッシーっていうやつだね。濡れ透けとか、制服が張りついてるのとか、チンポに効いちゃうんでしょ？
text.en: Hehe… "wet and messy," right? The clingy, see-through fabric, the uniform sticking to you… it must be driving you wild, huh?

text.ja: あんっ、やぁんっ……ケダモノになってるぅ……いいよぉ、ここでしよ？　学校のプールで、ラブラブ生ハメオマンコ、しちゃお？
text.en: Ahh, yaaa… you're turning into a monster… it's fine, let's do it right here? At the school pool, a lovey-dovey, raw…?

text.ja: はぁむぅ……んちゅっ、ちゅぱぁっ……えへへぇ……雨の中、つながったまんまのキスハメぇ……れろぉぉぉ……きもひいいぃ……
text.en: Haa… nchu, chupa… ehehe… a nonstop kiss-fuck in the rain… leloo… so hot…
